answer: Each agent deposits bonded stake and proves Semaphore membership before evaluating its assigned share of an epoch polynomial, binding RLN messages to a committed identity. Reusing a rate-limit nullifier in the same epoch exposes two Shamir shares; anyone can interpolate the private key, verify the fault, and trigger immediate collateral slashing. Thus hollow Sybil accounts face a real cost, while honest agents can wander across epochs without linkability—even in a gale of activity.
